Yes. x402 supports pay-per-call and peer-to-peer payments between agents on Pharos Pacific Mainnet. Configure your service for **USDC** on network `eip155:1672` (chain ID `1672`).

* **Token:** USDC, 6 decimals
* **Contract:** `0xc879c018db60520f4355c26ed1a6d572cdac1815`

Set the endpoint’s x402 price in USDC, then use that token address as the payment asset. For example, the mainnet guide shows `0.01` USDC converted to `10000` base units. See the [x402 Pacific Mainnet](/developer-guide/x402/x402-pacific-mainnet) and [Token Registry](/getting-started/token-registry).
